source_title: Severfield plc Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 150 and 186 state that the financial statements were approved by the Board of Directors on 19 June 2019; issuer-linked report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue was broadly flat amid softer UK markets and project delays, but underlying operating profit increased 2%, margin improved from 8.3% to 8.5%, profit before tax increased, and the UK and Europe order book rose to £295m. Year-end net funds remained £25.1m after dividends and investment, while management reported continuing operational-execution gains.
already_announced_exclusion: The 2013 Group restructuring, the completed 2018 North Yorkshire fabrication consolidation and the existing operational-improvement programme disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Limited market and scheduling pressure was more than offset by improved profit and margin, a materially larger diversified order book, positive net funds and quantified operational progress.

source_title: Severfield plc Annual Report and Accounts 2021
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 172 and 211 state that the financial statements were approved by the Board of Directors on 16 June 2021; issuer-linked report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: COVID-19 disruption reduced underlying operating profit from £27.0m to £25.5m, margin from 8.2% to 7.0%, underlying profit before tax from £28.6m to £24.3m and Indian revenue and margin sharply. Group revenue nevertheless rose 11%, operating cash conversion reached 93%, the UK and Europe order book rose to £301m, the Indian order book reached a record £140m and the Group retained £4.4m net funds after acquisitions.
already_announced_exclusion: COVID-19 working-practice changes, the existing Smarter Safer more Sustainable efficiency programme, completed process streamlining and the Harry Peers and DAM Structures acquisitions disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: The pandemic caused material profit and margin pressure and an Indian loss, but the UK business recovered to normal trading, revenue and both order books grew, cash conversion exceeded target and the balance sheet remained in net funds.

source_title: Severfield plc Annual Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 182 and 225 state that the financial statements were approved by the Board of Directors on 14 June 2023; issuer-linked report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue increased 22%, underlying operating profit 23% and statutory profit before tax 29%, while the UK and Europe order book reached £510m. The 6.7% margin remained below the former 8-10% range because steel-price pass-through diluted the percentage without reducing profit; net debt reversed to £2.7m net funds, cash conversion reached 145%, working capital normalised and committed facilities provided considerable headroom.
already_announced_exclusion: The April 2022 streamlining into three divisions, existing factory-efficiency programmes and the Harry Peers, DAM Structures and VSCH transactions disclosed or completed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Softer conditions and delayed client decisions were limited pressures. Record revenue, higher profit, a substantially larger diversified order book, net funds, strong cash conversion and facility headroom provide unusually strong quantified offsets.
